auditor_jaideep: Hi folks — for the SOC2 spot-check we need a reproducible evidence bundle showing a cross-account KMS grant use and the RBAC approval trail for the window 2026-03-15 13:30-14:30 UTC. Deliverables: KMS API events, cross-account grant details, role assumption traces, approval ticket PDF, and an integrity story. Who can own and what will be included?

emily-sec: I can own. Plan: (1) CloudTrail KMS events for Decrypt/GenerateDataKey/ReEncrypt/CreateGrant/RetireGrant; (2) AWS CLI snapshots (list-grants, describe-key, list-aliases); (3) STS AssumeRole logs; (4) ticket export + approver SSO event; (5) export recipe + savedsearch job ids + sha/gpg signing. cc @max-ops for upload.

max-ops: evidence-bot created ticket SEC-9134 :white_check_mark:

evidence-bot: Ticket SEC-9134 created, assignee: emily-sec, priority: high.

emily-sec: Splunk savedsearch: "crossacct_kms_grant_use_v1". Query I'll run (paste into search head):
```
index=cloudtrail eventSource=kms.amazonaws.com (eventName=Decrypt OR eventName=GenerateDataKey OR eventName=ReEncrypt OR eventName=CreateGrant OR eventName=RetireGrant) earliest=2862004200 latest=2862007800 | table _time eventName userIdentity.arn requestParameters.keyId requestParameters.grantId sourceIPAddress awsRegion eventID
```

emily-sec: For cross-account correlation we'll also pull the target account's CloudTrail (where allowed) or the GrantId mapping from our KMS `list-grants` output. Include `GrantTokens` if present.

auditor_jaideep: Need to prove grant was intentionally created and approved. Include the ticket thread (PDF), approver Okta event (eventId + hashed principal), and a screencap of the approval UI with visible timestamp. No raw tokens.

emily-sec: ok. We'll export okta_audit lines and include `eventId` + `actor.id` hashed. We'll include a redaction_map.csv mapping salted hashes to redacted values.

max-ops: Upload plan: tarball -> compute sha256 and sha512 -> sign checksum with GPG key id 0xDEAFBEEF -> upload to s3://redwood-evidence/sec9134/ with SSE-KMS and x-amz-meta-uploader=max-ops; capture PutObject CloudTrail event. presign created for auditor (24h). Example presign cmd we'll record:
```
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-evidence/sec9134/sec9134_bundle.tgz --expires-in 86400 --region us-east-1
```

emily-sec: Packaging checklist to include in bundle_manifest.txt: - kms_events.ndjson (Splunk export) - sts_assumerole.ndjson - aws_kms_list_grants.json - aws_kms_describe_key.json - okta_approver_lines.ndjson - ticket_SEC-9134.pdf - approval_screenshot.png - redaction_map.csv - export_recipe.sh - savedsearch_job.json - bundle.sha256 - bundle.sha512 - bundle.sha256.asc (gpg sig) - s3_put_event.json - control_mapping.csv

auditor_jaideep: For chain-of-custody we need exact CLI commands, Splunk job ids, savedsearch definition, upload metadata (version id, encryption headers), and an RFC3161 timestamp token if possible.

emily-sec: we'll timestamp the checksum with RFC3161 TSA and include the .tsr receipt. Commands we'll record: `tar -czf sec9134_bundle.tgz <files>` `sha256sum sec9134_bundle.tgz > sec9134_bundle.sha256` `sha512sum sec9134_bundle.tgz > sec9134_bundle.sha512` `rfc3161-client --tsa https://tsa.redwood.ai --digestfile sec9134_bundle.sha256 --out sec9134_bundle.sha256.tsr` `gpg --armor --detach-sign --local-user 0xDEAFBEEF sec9134_bundle.sha256`

max-ops: note on redaction: we will redact external IPs but preserve internal service CIDRs (e.g., 10.0.0.0/8) and principal ARNs. redaction_map.csv will list salted hashes and rationale.

emily-sec: vuln triage note: if any KMS activity overlaps a CVE window, we'll include vuln_context.md with timeline and mitigation steps. Also include `patch_status.csv` showing whether relevant CVEs were patched on the timeline.

auditor_jaideep: Also need proof that cross-account principal had the expected permissions: include grant's operations and grantee principal, plus any policy diffs (infra git commit hashes).

emily-sec: will include `kms_policy_diff.txt` from infra repo (commit range) and `grant_lifecycle.md` tying grant events to ticket IDs and job ids. Savedsearch job id: 9811223344 (I'll include job JSON).

max-ops: upload done. presign shared off-channel. manifest sha256: 7f6b2c3d4a9e8f1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0e1f2a3b4c5d6e7f8a9b0c1d2e3f4a5

auditor_jaideep: checksum verified. I'll validate control mapping and reproduction steps. One ask: retention period for this evidence?

tara-compliance: retention note: evidence for cross-account grants retained 540 days under legal hold due to cross-border review, then archived per policy. Documented in `retention_policy_note.txt`.

emily-sec: final note: included Splunk job JSON, savedsearch XML, and exact export_recipe.sh so auditors can reproduce. Closing thread unless auditor requests additional artifacts. :thumbsup:
